Tarawa.overnight_28_29: Isolated bombproof groups and individual holdouts continue scattered fire; no reconstitution of coherent defense occurs.
Tarawa.Japanese_remaining_groups: Most final coherent groups destroyed during night/dawn reduction; small numbers of isolated holdouts remain a mop-up/security problem.
Tarawa.final_assessment: US tactical/operational victory. The 24-Nov tide/lane choice prevents beachhead failure, but pre-GALVANIC Branch-B construction/logistics hardening materially raises first-two-day losses and extends high-intensity support demand through 28 Nov.

Makin.support_release: CVE/surface/transport assets continue staged reorganization and release; some support shifted toward Tarawa on 28 Nov, remaining elements begin broader post-assault tasks after Tarawa secure declaration.

US_naval_air.CVE_system: Eight-CVE assault-air wallet remains intact; no centered CVE loss. It has paid materially more CAS/spotting/ASW deck cycles than the old quicker-Tarawa line.
US_naval_air.fast_carriers: Independence campaign-out; Lexington heavy mission-kill withdrawing; Yorktown useful again; other fast decks cover assault area and Japanese carrier withdrawal rather than conduct an automatic historical 4-Dec mass raid.
US_naval_air.surface_screen: One currently unnamed outer-screen DD lost in 26/27 Tarawa Type-93 raid; exact hull identity remains open.

Japan_naval_air.carriers: Shokaku/Zuikaku/Hiryu operational; Soryu damaged but not campaign mission-killed centered. Secondary carriers continue cross-deck/CAP/recovery support during withdrawal.
Japan_naval_air.surface: Hatsuzuki/Suzutsuki/Hamakaze/Fujinami withdraw; Fujinami light-moderate damage. No second 27/28 raid centered.
Japan_naval_air.submarine: I-175 remains available as a degraded patrol asset rather than entering the old heavy-repair clock; no compensating 28-Nov hit booked.
